title: Pet Rent Rate Card for the Pet Addendum
content:
Monthly pet rent under the Pet Addendum is set per addendum type. Each column of this card is one addendum type; each row is one pet rent term.

| Pet rent term | Assistance Animal Accommodation | Caged Pet Addendum | Cat Addendum | Small Dog Addendum (under 25 lb) | Medium Dog Addendum (25-49 lb) | Large Dog Addendum (50-90 lb) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly pet rent (USD per month) | 0.00 | 10.00 | 35.00 | 40.00 | 50.00 | 65.00 |
| Day of the month pet rent posts | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Partial first or last month prorated | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Months pet rent is held after approval | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Calendar days of written notice before an increase after that hold | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Discount on the monthly pet rent of each pet after the first on the lease | 0% | 0% | 25% | 25% | 20% | 20% |

Notes to the card:

1. *Monthly pet rent* is the amount per month for one animal of the addendum type.
2. *Day of the month pet rent posts* is the calendar day on which each month's pet rent line posts — the 1st for every addendum type.
3. *Partial first or last month prorated* states whether pet rent for a partial first or last month is prorated. Only the Assistance Animal Accommodation reads "No", and its monthly pet rent is 0.00.
4. *Months pet rent is held after approval* is the period, counted from approval, during which the pet rent of the addendum is held — 12 months for every type.
5. *Calendar days of written notice* is the written notice, in calendar days, that must precede a pet rent increase once the hold has run — 30 days for every type.
6. *Discount on each pet after the first* is a fraction of that later pet's own monthly pet rent: 0.25 for the Cat Addendum and the Small Dog Addendum (under 25 lb), 0.2 for the Medium Dog Addendum (25-49 lb) and the Large Dog Addendum (50-90 lb), and 0 for the Caged Pet Addendum and the Assistance Animal Accommodation.

Worked reading (hypothetical situation, figures from the card): a Medium Dog Addendum (25-49 lb) animal that is a later pet on its lease has a discount of 20% of 50.00, that is 10.00 a month; a Caged Pet Addendum animal in the same position has a discount of 0% of 10.00, that is nothing.
